words.word: make it back into the open
words.trans: 短语：成功回到开阔地带；make it 固定习语——及时赶到、成功抵达、（劫后）活下来（不是"制作它"）
examples: By the time Tom made it back into the open, something was changing at the farm.
words.key: make it back into the open

words.trans: v. 强行迫降、坠毁着陆（飞机/无人机受损的着陆）
examples: It crash-landed into one of the outbuildings.

words.trans: v. 碎裂、解体、崩解（碎成碎片）
examples: Instead of simply disintegrating, it exploded on impact.

words.trans: 短语：撞击的一瞬间、一撞上就……
examples: Instead of simply disintegrating, it exploded on impact.

words.trans: 短语：沿着小路疾驰飞奔（slash 此处不是"切割"，形容车辆高速猛冲）
examples: The Toyota pickup that had brought Tom was slashing up the track.

words.trans: n. ①大羽毛、羽饰；②（烟、尘土、水汽腾起的）一股、一团、羽状物；plume of dust 一团滚滚尘土
examples: The Range Rovers came to a stop in front of the gates in a plume of dust.

words.trans: 短语：（人）大批涌出来、蜂拥而出
examples: Armed police began pouring out and swarming around the fence.

words.trans: 短语：蜂拥围拢、成群围住（swarm 蜂群般涌聚）
examples: Armed police began pouring out and swarming around the fence.

words.trans: adj. 怒发冲冠的、毛发竖立的、林立的；（bristle 现在分词）毛发竖起、被激怒、充满；guns bristling 是倒装（正常 bristling guns）= 到处枪炮林立
examples: He could see an open door and green-helmeted soldiers, guns bristling.

words.trans: 短语：自毁模式（机器/组织自我摧毁销毁证据）
examples: Tom knew the entire organization was being put into self-destruct mode.

words.trans: n. 地下涵洞、排水暗渠（路/堤下走水的封闭管道）
examples: The first one down the culvert would be surprised to find the grille already removed.

words.trans: adj. 荧光的、发荧光的（fluorescent markings 反光标识）
examples: Blue lights, fluorescent vehicle markings, traffic backed up on the pass.

words.trans: adj. 雕刻而成的、雕塑般的、有立体造型的
examples: It was the sculptured ice cream cone poking above a stone wall that made Tom look closer.

words.trans: adj. 静脉内的（intra- 内 + vein 静脉；intravenous syringe 静脉注射器）
examples: An intravenous syringe filled with anaesthetic, ready to sink into flesh.

words.trans: v. 步履沉重费力地走、跋涉（累得拖步走）
examples: He spotted a boy trudging along the path, all alone.

words.trans: n.（复数）亲信、爪牙、跟班手下
examples: Snakey had lost his grip on his henchmen.

words.trans: n. 注射器、注射筒；v. 用注射器注射/冲洗
examples: An intravenous syringe filled with anaesthetic was still loaded in the drone.

words.trans: n. 山间隘口、山路关口（翻山的低口）
examples: Traffic was backed up on the pass.

words.trans: adj. 泥泞的、沼泽般的（bog 沼泽的形容词）
examples: In a boggy depression fifty yards from the road, a black Land Rover lay on its side.

words.trans: n.（本义）地面低洼处、凹地（此处非"情绪抑郁"义）
examples: In a boggy depression fifty yards from the road a black Land Rover lay on its side.

words.trans: 短语：侧翻、车身歪倒在地
examples: A black Land Rover lay on its side, windows shattered.

words.trans: 短语：像手风琴一样挤压变形撞向……（concertina 六角手风琴；动词表物体受挤压褶皱收缩）
examples: The ice cream van had concertinaed itself into a drystone wall.

words.word: rammed up the side of a bank
words.trans: 短语：猛撞到土坡上（ram 猛撞）
examples: A builders' dump truck was rammed up the side of a bank, its bucket hoisted like a sail.
words.key: rammed up the side of a bank

words.trans: 短语：一阵骤然袭来的恐惧（jolt n. 猛然一惊、剧烈震动）
examples: When Tom recognized Archie, the jolt of fear felt like his insides had spun through a propeller.

words.trans: n. 急救人员、护理救护员（paramedical 人员）
examples: The dog was being lifted down from the truck by a paramedic.

words.trans: v.（发动机、旋翼）失速、停转（航空术语：气流分离失去升力）；n. 摊位；拖延
examples: The relief made him almost stall the drone.

words.trans: 短语：铝箔保温急救毯（事故现场用来保暖的银色应急毯）
examples: Maggie was being wrapped in a foil blanket by a paramedic.

words.trans: 短语：俯冲掠过（鸟/飞行器俯冲着快速飞过）
examples: To get the right angle of approach Tom swooped past.

words.trans: adj. 模糊不清的、难以分辨的（轮廓/声音不清晰）
examples: Indistinct faces turned towards him like Lego people.

words.trans: 短语：（瞄准镜/准星的）十字准星
examples: Tom lined the ponytail up in the cross hairs and fired a dart.

words.trans: adj. 毫无悔意的、冷酷无情的（remorse 悔恨 + -less）
examples: Tom looked into those remorseless eyes and fired another dart.

words.trans: adj. 沾着一道道血迹的（streak v. 留下条状痕迹；streaked 带条纹的）
examples: Maggie's blood-streaked face tilted up at the machine.

words.trans: 两种用法：①认出、辨认出来（动作含义）；②表彰、嘉奖（in recognition of one's service）
examples: She gave a wave in recognition.

words.trans: n. 意外转折、变故；（故事）反转（字面"拧成一股"→事态离奇转折）
examples: By some twist of events, Snakey had lost his grip on his henchmen.

words.trans: 短语：谁也想不到、事情居然这样反转；阴差阳错之下
examples: He grinned at the thought that by some twist of events Snakey had lost his grip.

words.trans: 短语：刺入肉里、扎进皮肉中
examples: The anaesthetic dart was ready to sink into flesh at the press of a button.

words.trans: adj. 令人沉醉的、使人飘飘然的（此处指权力带来的眩晕感，不是酒精喝醉）
examples: An intoxicating feeling of power swept over him like a wave.

words.trans: 短语：（飞镖/箭上的）稳定尾翼；本义鸟类飞羽（翅膀上用于飞的大羽毛）
examples: The dart flew silent and accurate, its flight feathers in perfect balance.

words.trans: 短语：黄蜂蜇伤（比喻针刺般的微小刺痛）
examples: The piercing of the skin would feel little more than a wasp sting.

words.trans: 短语：辨认出来、分辨出（从一堆背景里找出目标）
examples: He glanced to the south and picked out the shape of the long white steamer.

words.trans: n. 蒸汽轮船
examples: He picked out the shape of the long white steamer carving through the islands.

words.trans: 短语：一连串林木覆盖的小岛（string 一串/一连串）
examples: The steamer carved her way through the string of wooded islands.

words.trans: 短语：点缀着、散布着（某地遍布某物，像钉了铆钉一样）
examples: The lake stretched to rolling hills studded with whitewashed farmhouses.

words.trans: v. 断裂、碎裂、（使）破裂；n. 裂缝、骨折
examples: The lens flared and fractured, and dazzling light filled the screen.

words.trans: 短语：刺眼的碎光光斑（dazzle 使目眩）
examples: Dazzling flakes of light like rough-cut crystals filled the screen.

words.trans: 名词短语：粗切割的水晶（rough-cut 粗加工的）
examples: Dazzling flakes of light like rough-cut crystals filled the screen.

words.trans: adj. 缺氧的（-starved 复合形容词后缀：缺少……的）
examples: A few seconds before his oxygen-starved brain blacked out.

words.trans: 短语：昏厥、失去意识；眼前发黑
examples: His oxygen-starved brain blacked out in the dark.

words.trans: 短语：慢慢消散、化为乌有（像融化般消失）
examples: He could feel the lonely years of rage melting away.

words.trans: 短语：（情绪浪潮）席卷某人，某种强烈情绪瞬间淹没笼罩住人
examples: An intoxicating feeling of power swept over him like a wave.

words.trans: 习语（英式高频）：为了万无一失、作为额外的保险、多做一点以防万一
examples: Tom fired another dart into his chest, and then another for good measure.
